API tests: live reports

Newman reports from the latest CI run on the main branch for the Restful-Booker API. Secrets are redacted before the reports are saved.

Functional, contract and security run

Requests, assertions, response times and the expected failures that document known defects.

Validation matrix

Fourteen invalid and unusual request bodies sent through one request, showing which ones the API mishandles.

Data-driven run

The same create, read and delete flow over six data rows, including Unicode names.

Source code, the OpenAPI specification, test plan, coverage report and defect reports are in the GitHub repository. Part of the SQA portfolio.
